answer: Each challenge is cryptographically entangled with a domain-separated hash of the participant’s commitment and a future drand quicknet round, whose threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable until release. Responses must prove timely work against that value, so a swarm cannot precompute answers or farm a reusable offline cache; rate limits or stake still constrain identities. A sonnet on a terrace beside ferrous rails faces the same beacon-bound verification, not a privileged path.
